args: set -euo pipefail; jq 'del(.nodes[] | select(.id == "V-01")) | del(.edges[] | select(.from == "V-01" or .to == "V-01"))' plan/graph.json > /tmp/mtd-v08-scratch.json

set -euo pipefail; diff <(jq -r '.slices[] | .id as $s | .depends_on[] | "\($s) \(.)"' plan/build.json | sort) <(jq -r '.edges[] | select(.edge_type == "r.requires_completion") | "\(.from) \(.to)"' plan/graph.json | sort)

evidence_required: The compiler's rejection message for the scratch graph.
The depends_on to prerequisite-edge comparison against plan/contracts.md.
objective: Independently rebuild the compiler, reproduce the committed build bytes, confirm the compiler rejects a graph missing a verifier, and confirm every depends_on has a prerequisite edge.

outputs.purpose: QA verdict for S-08 with byte comparison and rejection evidence.

risk_controls: Run in a separate QA context that never implemented the slice; do not edit implementation files; a verdict is accept or reject with the failing check and defect list.
The compiler is rebuilt in QA's own disposable directory; the skill directory is never modified.
The verifier-deletion experiment runs on a scratch copy only.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's forbidden organisation name (grep pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden phrase (grep pattern needs[ ]you); plain, specific prose.
rollback: Delete qa/V-08 and the scratch files; the implementation branch is unchanged.
steps: Rebuild the compiler in its own disposable directory.
Compile, and compare bytes with the committed plan/build.json and plan/contracts/*.json.
Delete one verifier slice from a scratch copy of the graph and confirm the compiler rejects it.
Confirm every depends_on in plan/contracts.md matches a prerequisite edge.
